business_problem: Shenqiu County needed to serve a large and mobile population more efficiently while reducing the data-entry burden on grassroots staff and giving residents faster, more accurate access to government information and services.
solution_summary: For Shenqiu County, partner Wuhan Zhongwei Huitong built a grassroots-governance assistant on Baidu AI Cloud's Qianfan stack. AppBuilder capabilities such as role instructions, speech recognition, online search, follow-up prompting, and workflow controls support resident-facing services across resident groups, personal assistants, mini-programs, official accounts, and H5 pages. Those channels connect to a local government knowledge base built from policy and document content so residents can get geographically specific answers to questions such as medical insurance, marriage registration, and household registration. On the government side, AppBuilder and ModelBuilder also support Copilot-style work-order creation and routing: natural-language inputs are turned into structured forms, then AI follows the standard government process to create, transfer, review, feed back, evaluate, and close work orders.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Drives the resident-assistant channels and the workflow logic used in grassroots government service delivery.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model capabilities for knowledge answering, intent understanding, and service automation.

solution_components.name: BaiGe Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the compute foundation for the county's large-model governance services.

data_flow: Resident questions arrive through chat groups, mini-programs, official accounts, or H5 pages and are answered from the local policy knowledge base or safe online search. Staff interactions are converted from natural language into structured work orders, which the AI then routes, reviews, and closes across the standard government process.
business_outcome: Shenqiu improved resident-service responsiveness, gave local staff a 24/7 assistant for knowledge and work orders, and reduced manual data-entry effort in grassroots operations.

After connecting the product matrix to ERNIE models, grid-worker efficiency rose 15%, resident response speed rose 30%, and resident satisfaction rose 50% (original: 中卫慧通产品矩阵接入百度文心大模型后…基层网格员服务居民效率提升 15%，居民服务响应速度提升 30%，居民满意度提升 50%).
